paragraphs.text: But know this, that in the last days grievous times shall come.
paragraphs.original: Τοῦτο δὲ γίνωσκε ὅτι ἐν ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις ἐνστήσονται καιροὶ χαλεποί·
paragraphs.translit: Touto de ginōske hoti en eschatais hēmerais enstēsontai kairoi chalepoi·

paragraphs.text: For men shall be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, haughty, railers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
paragraphs.original: ἔσονται γὰρ οἱ ἄνθρωποι φίλαυτοι, φιλάργυροι, ἀλαζόνες, ὑπερήφανοι, βλάσφημοι, γονεῦσιν ἀπειθεῖς, ἀχάριστοι, ἀνόσιοι,
paragraphs.translit: esontai gar hoi anthrōpoi philautoi, philargyroi, alazones, hyperēphanoi, blasphēmoi, goneusin apeitheis, acharistoi, anosioi,

paragraphs.text: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, no lovers of good,
paragraphs.original: ἄστοργοι, ἄσπονδοι, διάβολοι, ἀκρατεῖς, ἀνήμεροι, ἀφιλάγαθοι,
paragraphs.translit: astorgoi, aspondoi, diaboloi, akrateis, anēmeroi, aphilagathoi,

paragraphs.text: traitors, headstrong, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;
paragraphs.original: προδόται, προπετεῖς, τετυφωμένοι, φιλήδονοι μᾶλλον ἢ φιλόθεοι,
paragraphs.translit: prodotai, propeteis, tetyphōmenoi, philēdonoi mallon ē philotheoi,

paragraphs.text: holding a form of godliness, but having denied the power therefore. From these also turn away.
paragraphs.original: ἔχοντες μόρφωσιν εὐσεβείας τὴν δὲ δύναμιν αὐτῆς ἠρνημένοι· καὶ τούτους ἀποτρέπου.
paragraphs.translit: echontes morphōsin eusebeias tēn de dynamin autēs ērnēmenoi· kai toutous apotrepou.

paragraphs.text: For of these are they that creep into houses, and take captive silly women laden with sins, led away by divers lusts,
paragraphs.original: ἐκ τούτων γάρ εἰσιν οἱ ἐνδύνοντες εἰς τὰς οἰκίας καὶ αἰχμαλωτίζοντες γυναικάρια σεσωρευμένα ἁμαρτίαις, ἀγόμενα ἐπιθυμίαις ποικίλαις,
paragraphs.translit: ek toutōn gar eisin hoi endynontes eis tas oikias kai aichmalōtizontes gynaikaria sesōreumena hamartiais, agomena epithymiais poikilais,

paragraphs.text: ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
paragraphs.original: πάντοτε μανθάνοντα καὶ μηδέποτε εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν δυνάμενα.
paragraphs.translit: pantote manthanonta kai mēdepote eis epignōsin alētheias elthein dynamena.

paragraphs.text: And even as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also withstand the truth. Men corrupted in mind, reprobate concerning the faith.
paragraphs.original: ὃν τρόπον δὲ Ἰάννης καὶ Ἰαμβρῆς ἀντέστησαν Μωϋσεῖ, οὕτως καὶ οὗτοι ἀνθίστανται τῇ ἀληθείᾳ, ἄνθρωποι κατεφθαρμένοι τὸν νοῦν, ἀδόκιμοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν.
paragraphs.translit: hon tropon de Iannēs kai Iambrēs antestēsan Mōysei, houtōs kai houtoi anthistantai tē alētheia, anthrōpoi katephtharmenoi ton noun, adokimoi peri tēn pistin.

paragraphs.text: But they shall proceed no further. For their folly shall be evident unto all men, as theirs also came to be.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλʼ οὐ προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ πλεῖον, ἡ γὰρ ἄνοια αὐτῶν ἔκδηλος ἔσται πᾶσιν, ὡς καὶ ἡ ἐκείνων ἐγένετο.
paragraphs.translit: allʼ ou prokopsousin epi pleion, hē gar anoia autōn ekdēlos estai pasin, hōs kai hē ekeinōn egeneto.

paragraphs.text: But thou didst follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, patience,
paragraphs.original: Σὺ δὲ παρηκολούθησάς μου τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ, τῇ ἀγωγῇ, τῇ προθέσει, τῇ πίστει, τῇ μακροθυμίᾳ, τῇ ἀγάπῃ, τῇ ὑπομονῇ,
paragraphs.translit: Sy de parēkolouthēsas mou tē didaskalia, tē agōgē, tē prothesei, tē pistei, tē makrothymia, tē agapē, tē hypomonē,

paragraphs.text: persecutions, sufferings. What things befell me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured. And out of them all the Lord delivered me.
paragraphs.original: τοῖς διωγμοῖς, τοῖς παθήμασιν, οἷά μοι ἐγένετο ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ, ἐν Ἰκονίῳ, ἐν Λύστροις, οἵους διωγμοὺς ὑπήνεγκα· καὶ ἐκ πάντων με ἐρρύσατο ὁ κύριος.
paragraphs.translit: tois diōgmois, tois pathēmasin, hoia moi egeneto en Antiocheia, en Ikoniō, en Lystrois, hoious diōgmous hypēnenka· kai ek pantōn me errysato ho kyrios.

paragraphs.text: Yea, and all that would live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάντες δὲ οἱ θέλοντες ζῆν εὐσεβῶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διωχθήσονται·
paragraphs.translit: kai pantes de hoi thelontes zēn eusebōs en Christō Iēsou diōchthēsontai·

paragraphs.text: But evil men and impostors shall wax worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
paragraphs.original: πονηροὶ δὲ ἄνθρωποι καὶ γόητες προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ τὸ χεῖρον, πλανῶντες καὶ πλανώμενοι.
paragraphs.translit: ponēroi de anthrōpoi kai goētes prokopsousin epi to cheiron, planōntes kai planōmenoi.

paragraphs.text: But abide thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them.
paragraphs.original: σὺ δὲ μένε ἐν οἷς ἔμαθες καὶ ἐπιστώθης, εἰδὼς παρὰ τίνων ἔμαθες,
paragraphs.translit: sy de mene en hois emathes kai epistōthēs, eidōs para tinōn emathes,

paragraphs.text: And that from a babe thou hast known the sacred writings which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ βρέφους ἱερὰ γράμματα οἶδας, τὰ δυνάμενά σε σοφίσαι εἰς σωτηρίαν διὰ πίστεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: kai hoti apo brephous hiera grammata oidas, ta dynamena se sophisai eis sōtērian dia pisteōs tēs en Christō Iēsou·

paragraphs.text: Every scripture inspired of God [is] also profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction which is in righteousness.
paragraphs.original: πᾶσα γραφὴ θεόπνευστος καὶ ὠφέλιμος πρὸς διδασκαλίαν, πρὸς ἐλεγμόν, πρὸς ἐπανόρθωσιν, πρὸς παιδείαν τὴν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ,
paragraphs.translit: pasa graphē theopneustos kai ōphelimos pros didaskalian, pros elegmon, pros epanorthōsin, pros paideian tēn en dikaiosynē,

paragraphs.text: That the man of God may be complete, furnished completely unto every good work.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα ἄρτιος ᾖ ὁ τοῦ θεοῦ ἄνθρωπος, πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἐξηρτισμένος.
paragraphs.translit: hina artios ē ho tou theou anthrōpos, pros pan ergon agathon exērtismenos.
